title: Quest Quiz
description: Mixed review rounds from everything you have learned.

levels.title: Quest Round 1
levels.lessonText: Let's begin the quest! Answer questions from what you know.
levels.prompt: Which picture starts with the sound /a/?

levels.title: Quest Round 2
levels.lessonText: Round two! Think carefully and choose the best answer.
levels.prompt: How many legs does a spider have?

levels.title: Quest Round 3
levels.lessonText: Keep going! You are getting stronger with every question.

levels.title: Quest Round 4
levels.lessonText: The quest gets a little harder. You can do it!
levels.prompt: Two birds join three birds. How many birds in all?

levels.title: Quest Round 5
levels.lessonText: Halfway through the quest! Stay focused and keep learning.
levels.prompt: Your friend has no pencil. What is the kind choice?

levels.title: Quest Round 6
levels.lessonText: Round six! Blend the sounds to find the word.
levels.prompt: Blend the sounds /k/ /a/ /t/. What word is it?

levels.title: Quest Round 7
levels.lessonText: Great focus! Compare the two groups carefully.
levels.prompt: Eight stars or six stars. Which group has fewer?

levels.title: Quest Round 8
levels.lessonText: Round eight! Mix colors in your mind.
levels.prompt: Blue plus yellow makes which color?

levels.title: Quest Round 9
levels.lessonText: Almost there! Think about honesty and kindness.
levels.prompt: You broke a cup by accident. What is the honest choice?

levels.title: Quest Finale
levels.lessonText: You reached the final round! Show everything you have learned.
levels.prompt: Four cats plus four cats. How many cats in all?
